name: Hellhound
description: A hellhound is a fearsome, infernal canine with jet-black fur and glowing red eyes that burn like embers. These malevolent creatures exhale searing flames and have an insatiable hunger for souls, often serving as guardians or hunters for powerful masters. They are known for their keen senses and incredibly fast speed.

actions.name: Flame Bite
actions.description: The hellhound bites a creature with it's fiery mouth, dealing physical and fire damage.

actions.name: Infernal Dash
actions.description: While taking the move action, the hellhound turns into pure flame and dashes to a point within it's remaining movement speed, becoming a line of fire 1 unit wide that deals fire damage. On a true hit, all creatures gain the ignited condition.

actions.name: Entrapping Bite
actions.description: The hellhound attempts to grip the legs medium or smaller creature by making an attack that does minimal damage. On a hit, the target is trapped and must make a strength or acrobatics check of 10 or higher. While trapping a creature in this way, the hellhound cannot use their Flame Bite action.

actions.name: Reactive Leap
actions.description: In response to being targeted by a melee attack, the hellhound attempts to leap to an unoccupied tile within 2 units without provoking reactions and gaining a 1d4 bonus to their block or dodge check.

actions.name: Expel Flames
actions.description: The hellhound shoots scorching fire from it's mouth in a 3-unit cone, dealing fire damage to all creatures within the area. This attack can only be used once per combat.

actions.name: Consume Soul
actions.description: While adjacent to a humanoid or beast that has died within the last minute, the hellhound consumes their soul and gains 3d12 health. The dead creature cannot be resurrected or returned to life unless until the hellhound is killed, at which point the soul is released.
